FINAL REPORT — /rebar-debug on 3581-9cf1 (acli undeclared/undocumented prereq)

RESOLUTION: FIXED. Landed via Gerrit change 2397 (MERGED, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Ticket closed, class=preexisting.

ROOT CAUSE (proven): The Jira Cloud reconciler/bridge spawns the Atlassian CLI (`acli`) transport via subprocess, but the `[jira]`/`[agents]` extra never DECLARED or DOCUMENTED that `acli` must be installed on the host. A non-container `pip install` therefore succeeds, and then the first Cloud-mutating op reaches the bare `subprocess.Popen(["acli", ...])` and dies with an unguided `FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'acli'` (errno 2). Reproduced by stripping acli from PATH and calling `_run_acli(["jira","workitem","view","REB-1"])` → bare errno-2. Data Center path is independent (uses the `jira` REST library, never spawns acli).

DEDUP vs sibling 54e6 (royalistic-gorgeable-norwayrat, Gerrit 2370, MERGED): NOT a duplicate — different layer. 54e6 added pinned acli to the Docker MCP image (`infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp`) — the CONTAINER layer. 3581 is the distinct PACKAGE layer: the Python extra's declared + documented dependency contract for NON-container installs. 54e6 is the pattern/authority establishing acli as an accepted, pinned rebar dependency; this change completes the SAME contract for pip installs. No other package-layer ticket exists.

LEGITIMACY: incomplete-implementation — acli is an already-accepted, cited dependency (README, docs/jira-sync-setup.md, CI external-integration.yml, 54e6 merged, and a pre-existing pyproject "System prerequisites" comment naming it). Completing/documenting the contract is restoration, not a new feature/dependency.

CAUSED_BY: unattributable (left unset). The acli transport, the pyproject extras, and the "System prerequisites…acli" comment all trace to the untrailered genesis import `b534f47a7f9b` (2026-06-08), which predates the rebar-ticket trailer convention. Date test REJECTS fd4a-4e91-f179-4932 (its Dockerfile.mcp commit 8297083532a3 is 2026-08-25, 2.5 months later and a different layer). This is the sanctioned unattributable path; close class = preexisting.

FIX (scope: declaration/preflight only — did NOT touch access_check.py, owned by ac93):
1. Documented the prereq: README.md (Cloud path requires acli + install pointer; `[jira-datacenter]` DC exempt), docs/jira-sync-setup.md (non-container/pip note), pyproject.toml (strengthened comment).
2. Typed the absence: added `AcliNotInstalledError(FileNotFoundError)`, `acli_binary_available()` and `require_acli()` preflight helpers, and wrapped the `_run_acli` Popen spawn to re-raise the bare errno-2 as the typed, actionable error naming acli + Cloud + docs/jira-sync-setup.md. Subclasses FileNotFoundError deliberately so ac93's future transport-internals handler still catches it (complementary, no collision).

TEST (held-out oracle the fixer never saw): tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_acli_preflight_missing_binary.py — 7 tests. RED before fix, GREEN after (7/7). Absence driven by real PATH manipulation (not monkeypatching the check). Mutation-checked inside macOS sandbox-exec (host has no `timeout`): (a) collapsing the Popen wrap → RED (bare errno-2 returns, exact original defect); (b) collapsing the preflight discrimination → 4 RED. Restore → 7 GREEN. Teeth confirmed.

STEP 7 SWEEP (other extras / bare-binary prereqs): CLEAN — acli was the unique outlier. Every other external-binary usage already degrades gracefully or preflights: conflict_bug_filing catches OSError→error tuple; metrics scc/_jscpd → "unavailable" metric; grounding engine_b and the s3 extra use shutil.which() preflight/abstain; remaining spawns are `git` (base tool). No sibling defect filed.

GATES: review-plan PASS (0 blocking, 4 advisory), signed/certified. make lint + mypy (692 files) clean. Complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0. Module size 659 LOC < 800. Full acli/jira regression suite 499 passed / 1 skipped.

SIBLINGS: 54e6 (pattern/authority, merged); ac93 (naval-cankered-stud, in_progress — boundary respected, no collision); fd4a (rejected origin).

GERRIT: change 2397 — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2397 — MERGED.
